_comment: Claude Code settings for AI Studio Accademia Milano. Hooks auto-updated by learning_loop.py and post_delivery_update.py.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git config core.hooksPath scripts/git-hooks && chmod +x scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit 2>/dev/null || true
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python scripts/learning_loop.py --event session_end --audit-dir process/audit --settings config/global_settings.json --claude-dir "$HOME/.claude"
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python scripts/delta_collector.py --date today --audit-dir process/audit --output process/deltas 2>&1 || true
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python scripts/learning_loop.py --event delivery_complete --audit-dir process/audit --settings config/global_settings.json --claude-dir "$HOME/.claude"
